_comment: Source: NetFile Richmond CA agency 163 committee registry. The 'city_fips' column on the committees table just means 'ingested via the Richmond pipeline' — committees auto-create when they appear in any Richmond filing as donor or recipient, including non-Richmond entities like Richmond District Democratic Club (an SF club). This file is the authoritative source for whether a filer is genuinely registered with Richmond's NetFile agency. Regenerate via: mcp__netfile__get_committee_info(city='Richmond'). Last refreshed: 2026-05-01.
